Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4p1lak$5...@vixen.cso.uiuc.edu>,

Mikel L. Matthews Jr. <gh...@firefly.prairienet.org> wrote:
>
>I've a question on Cryptic Rider. If I throw
>a Cryptic Rider down, do I then immediaetly
>throw another vote, or do I have another
>minion throw the vote?

Another minion (a vampire, actually) must call another
vote (and remain unblocked) in order for the Cryptic Rider
to be fulfilled.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
You have to go through the process of calling another vote (e.g., taking
an action without being blocked) in order to take advantage of Cryptic Rider.
